caption:
"Why would I pay an agent?" A fair question — here is the honest answer.

You can absolutely file it yourself. Plenty of people do, and plenty of them are fine.

The comparison that matters is not our fee versus free. It is our fee versus one refusal: a non-refundable fee, rebooked flights, leave you already requested, and a refusal that sits on your record.

Some files are straightforward. If yours is, we will say so.
